title: American Greed
description:
S13 E1 — The College Admissions Scandal
College admissions coach Rick Singer accepts money from parents to have their kids admitted to elite colleges.

title: American Greed
description:
S11 E5 — Clean Teeth, Dirty Money; Comic Book Murder
A sex trafficking ring, comprised of violent pimps who exploit women, enlists a Chicago dentist to launder their money; a plot to steal a valuable comic book collection ends in murder.

title: American Greed
description:
S10 E19 — Family Fortune Feud
A once $100 million publishing fortune creates tension between mother and son when he's accused of squandering millions on sex, diamonds and fraud.

title: American Greed
description:
S10 E17 — Seattle Roasted; The Stealing Socialite
Darren Berg of Seattle, scams several investors, procuring himself two yachts, a private jet and a lakeside mansion; New York socialite Dina Wein Reis executes a gray market selling scam.

title: American Greed
description:
S10 E15 — Medical Gloves With Holes
A fraudster in California promises to build a medical glove factory in the U.S. and steals millions of dollars from investors.

title: Super Heists
description:
S1 E1 — All the President's Money?
The best bank robbers in American history hatch an ingenious plan to steal 30 million from a rumored Nixon slush fund, sparking the biggest FBI manhunt since the Kennedy assassination.

title: Super Heists
description:
S1 E2 — Secrets of the Transy Book Heist
Four clean-cut college students risk it all to become super-thieves by targeting $12 million in rare books in a brash daylight heist that baffles the cops hunting them.

title: Super Heists
description:
S1 E3 — A Van Full of Dollars
A model bank employee pulls off the second-biggest cash heist in history when he stuffs a work van with $17 million in untraceable cash and flees to Mexico, only to be betrayed by his partners when greed fuels a murder plot.

title: Super Heists
description:
S1 E4 — The Inside Job
When a violent gang of bank robbers executes a perfect heist, cops don't realize that one of the terrified bank tellers is actually the mastermind behind it all.

title: Super Heists
description:
S1 E5 — The Picasso Thief
When an irreplaceable Picasso is plucked from a gallery wall, cops know they have just 24 hours to track the thief down before it's likely gone for good.

title: Super Heists
description:
S1 E6 — The Heist of the Century
TV cameras are there when armed bank robbers take hostages at a large, international bank; police don't realize the robbery only masks a more spectacular heist taking place right under their feet.
